deterministic_algorithms.definition: Same input hashes, same software/environment identity, same configuration, same declared seed state, and same output or tolerance-equivalent output.

tolerance_equivalent: floating-point metric arrays only when tolerance is declared before comparison

deterministic_algorithms.nondeterminism: Must be attributed to a source (parallel scheduling, backend, hardware, unseeded library, numerical reduction, or other observed cause); a bare nondeterminism flag is insufficient.

repeat_policy.reason: No Stage 3 dataset/model or statistical power analysis exists in H1.

stochastic_ml_and_optimization.h1_authorization: No stochastic ML/optimization experiment is started in H1.

seed_defaults.cuda_deterministic: must be explicitly recorded; no assumption
seed_defaults.note: Defaults are contract test fixtures, not evidence that a future model is deterministic.

provenance: attached Stage 3 H1 request: deterministic and stochastic reproducibility requirements
